mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and ethambutol may have minor effects on drug clearance; additive anticholinergic effects possible with tolterodine's antimuscarinic activity.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic side effects (constipation, urinary retention, blurred vision); dose adjustment of tolterodine may be needed if adverse effects emerge during concurrent ethambutol therapy.
